description: Baseline review framing for ordinary single-mesh families, read by generate-family-review.mjs. Capture cameras and base outfits follow the reviewed ordinary-batch and pilot geometry configs. These are starting points only: screenshots still need visual review, and families may need extra fitting, occlusion or regression scenarios.

notes: The rear outfit view is where the Varsity cuff gap was found; inspect cuffs, collar and hem against the base outfit, and add combined-outfit scenarios for garments that interact with gloves or bags.

bare-waist-rear removes the upper-body garment so the rear waistband is not hidden by a shirt; its waist-height camera is a baseline value that needs visual confirmation. Boot and footwear tucking is not covered.

A-pose captures measure the positive-X hand. Idle uses a wider root-centered outfit view because a close rotating camera can enter the torso and lose the glove. The outfit hand views use fixed A-pose cameras near x=+/-0.55, y=0.95 so the negative-X hand is also seen; they are not measured per item and need visual confirmation that each hand is framed. Sleeve and jacket cuff overlap needs extra scenarios.
Straps and bags are checked only over the base T-shirt; jackets, vests and other back accessories may need extra overlap scenarios.

Camera reuses the reviewed Large Sneakers capture configuration. Root-centered eight-angle A/idle views include both shoes; inspect toe, sole, ankle, cuff and bare-calf coverage. A shared starting profile, not per-item fit acceptance. Different trouser shapes and source-supported shrink transitions need extra scenarios.
